import os
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
import torchvision
import torchvision.transforms as transforms
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, Dataset
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from PIL import Image
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Set device
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
print(f"Using device: {device}")

# Paths
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Load labels and sample submission
print("Loading data...")
labels_df = pd.read_csv(f"{INPUT_DIR}/labels.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv(f"{INPUT_DIR}/sample_submission.csv")

# Get breed order from sample submission
breed_columns = list(sample_submission.columns[1:])
num_classes = len(breed_columns)
print(f"Number of classes: {num_classes}")
print(f"Breed columns: {breed_columns[:5]}... {breed_columns[-5:]}")

# Create breed mapping
breed_to_idx = {breed: i for i, breed in enumerate(breed_columns)}
idx_to_breed = {i: breed for breed, i in breed_to_idx.items()}

# Filter labels to ensure consistent breeds
labels_df = labels_df[labels_df["breed"].isin(breed_to_idx.keys())]
print(f"Labels after filtering: {len(labels_df)}")

# Split training data into train and validation (hold-out)
train_df, val_df = train_test_split(
    labels_df, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=labels_df["breed"]
)
print(f"Train samples: {len(train_df)}, Val samples: {len(val_df)}")


# Create paths for images
def prepare_paths(df):
    df["image_path"] = df["id"].apply(
        lambda x: os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train", f"{x}.jpg")
    )
    return df


train_df = prepare_paths(train_df)
val_df = prepare_paths(val_df)

# Prepare test paths
test_ids = pd.read_csv(f"{INPUT_DIR}/sample_submission.csv")["id"].values
test_image_paths = [os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test", f"{id}.jpg") for id in test_ids]
print(f"Test samples: {len(test_ids)}")

# Data transforms with enhanced augmentation
mean = [0.485, 0.456, 0.406]
std = [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]

train_transform = transforms.Compose(
    [
        transforms.Resize(256),
        transforms.RandomResizedCrop(224, scale=(0.7, 1.0)),
        transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(),
        transforms.RandomRotation(15),
        transforms.ColorJitter(brightness=0.3, contrast=0.3, saturation=0.2, hue=0.1),
        transforms.ToTensor(),
        transforms.Normalize(mean, std),
    ]
)

val_transform = transforms.Compose(
    [
        transforms.Resize(256),
        transforms.CenterCrop(224),
        transforms.ToTensor(),
        transforms.Normalize(mean, std),
    ]
)


# Dataset class
class DogDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, transform=None):
        self.df = df
        self.transform = transform
        self.idx_map = breed_to_idx

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        path = self.df.iloc[idx]["image_path"]
        breed = self.df.iloc[idx]["breed"]
        img = Image.open(path).convert("RGB")
        img = self.transform(img)
        target = self.idx_map[breed]
        return img, target


train_dataset = DogDataset(train_df, train_transform)
val_dataset = DogDataset(val_df, val_transform)

# Create DataLoaders
train_loader = DataLoader(train_dataset, batch_size=32, shuffle=True, num_workers=4)
val_loader = DataLoader(val_dataset, batch_size=32, shuffle=False, num_workers=4)

# Model - ResNet18 with fine-tuning capability
print("Loading model...")
model = torchvision.models.resnet18(
    weights=torchvision.models.ResNet18_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1
)
num_ftrs = model.fc.in_features

# Replace classifier head
model.fc = nn.Sequential(nn.Dropout(0.4), nn.Linear(num_ftrs, num_classes))

# Unfreeze last 3 blocks of the backbone for fine-tuning
feature_extractor = model
for param in feature_extractor.parameters():
    param.requires_grad = False

# Unfreeze the last 3 residual blocks (indices 9, 10, 11 for ResNet18)
for name, param in feature_extractor.named_parameters():
    if "layer4" in name:
        param.requires_grad = True

print(
    f"Model parameters requiring grad: {sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad)}"
)

model = model.to(device)

# Loss and Optimizer with label smoothing
criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1)

# Split optimizer groups for different learning rates
base_params = []
layer4_params = []

for name, param in model.named_parameters():
    if "layer4" in name:
        layer4_params.append(param)
    else:
        base_params.append(param)

optimizer = optim.Adam(
    [
        {"params": base_params, "lr": 0.0001},
        {"params": layer4_params, "lr": 0.001},
    ],
    weight_decay=0.01,
)

# Learning rate scheduler
scheduler = optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingLR(optimizer, T_max=15, eta_min=0.00001)

# Training
print("Training model...")
epochs = 15
best_val_loss = float("inf")
best_model_state = None

for epoch in range(epochs):
    model.train()
    train_loss = 0.0

    for batch_idx, (images, targets) in enumerate(train_loader):
        images, targets = images.to(device), targets.to(device)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        outputs = model(images)
        loss = criterion(outputs, targets)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
        train_loss += loss.item()

    train_loss /= len(train_loader)

    # Validation
    model.eval()
    val_loss = 0.0
    all_preds = []
    all_targets = []

    with torch.no_grad():
        for images, targets in val_loader:
            images, targets = images.to(device), targets.to(device)
            outputs = model(images)
            loss = criterion(outputs, targets)
            val_loss += loss.item()

            # Collect for log loss calculation
            all_preds.append(outputs.detach().cpu().numpy())
            all_targets.append(np.eye(num_classes)[targets.cpu().numpy()])

    val_loss /= len(val_loader)

    # Calculate log loss for hold-out validation set
    eps = 1e-7
    all_preds_arr = np.vstack(all_preds)
    all_targets_arr = np.vstack(all_targets)
    y_pred_clipped = np.clip(all_preds_arr, eps, 1 - eps)
    y_true_one_hot = np.eye(num_classes)[all_targets_arr.argmax(axis=1)]
    log_loss = -np.mean(np.sum(y_true_one_hot * np.log(y_pred_clipped + 1e-7), axis=1))

    print(
        f"Epoch {epoch+1}/{epochs}, Train Loss: {train_loss:.4f}, Val Loss (CE): {val_loss:.4f}, Val Log Loss: {log_loss:.6f}"
    )

    if val_loss < best_val_loss:
        best_val_loss = val_loss
        best_model_state = model.state_dict().copy()
        print(f"New best model saved at epoch {epoch+1}")

    scheduler.step()

# Load best model
if best_model_state is not None:
    model.load_state_dict(best_model_state)
    print("Loaded best model")
else:
    print("WARNING: No best model found, training did not converge")

# Save submission
print("Generating submission...")

test_dataset_paths = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_ids})
test_dataset_paths["image_path"] = test_dataset_paths["id"].apply(
    lambda x: os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test", f"{x}.jpg")
)

model.eval()
all_test_preds = []

with torch.no_grad():
    for idx in range(len(test_ids)):
        img_path = test_dataset_paths.iloc[idx]["image_path"]
        img = Image.open(img_path).convert("RGB")
        img = (
            transforms.Compose(
                [
                    transforms.Resize(256),
                    transforms.CenterCrop(224),
                    transforms.ToTensor(),
                    transforms.Normalize(mean, std),
                ]
            )(img)
            .unsqueeze(0)
            .to(device)
        )

        output = model(img)
        probs = torch.softmax(output, dim=1).cpu().numpy()[0]
        all_test_preds.append(probs)

all_test_preds = np.vstack(all_test_preds)
print(f"Test predictions shape: {all_test_preds.shape}")

# Create submission dataframe
submission_df = pd.DataFrame()
submission_df["id"] = test_ids
for i, col in enumerate(breed_columns):
    submission_df[col] = all_test_preds[:, i]

submission_df.to_csv(f"{SUBMISSION_DIR}/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to submission/submission.csv with {len(test_ids)} rows")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission_df.shape}")

# Print hold-out validation multi-class log loss
all_preds_val = np.vstack(all_preds)
all_targets_val = np.vstack(all_targets)
eps = 1e-7
y_pred_clipped = np.clip(all_preds_val, eps, 1 - eps)
y_true_one_hot = np.eye(num_classes)[all_targets_val.argmax(axis=1)]
final_log_loss = -np.mean(
    np.sum(y_true_one_hot * np.log(y_pred_clipped + 1e-7), axis=1)
)
print(f"Multi-class Log Loss on Hold-out Validation Set: {final_log_loss:.6f}")

print("Done!")
